stories.title: Dutch GP — Nine Days Away, Teams Return to Factory August 17

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Nine days until Zandvoort.

Nine days until the LAST F1 race ever held at Circuit Zandvoort.

First-ever sprint weekend at the circuit. Summer factories reopen August 17.

Max Verstappen. Home race. Active exit clause. This is going to be something.

#F1 #DutchGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Dutch GP is a farewell event this year.

Zandvoort is hosting F1 for the last time on August 21-23. First sprint weekend in circuit history. Sold-out crowd. Martin Garrix performing.

And Verstappen's future decision looms over all of it.

#F1 #DutchGP #Zandvoort

stories.title: Verstappen Exit Clause — Active, October Deadline, McLaren in the Picture

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen's exit clause from Red Bull is now ACTIVE.

He entered the summer break 6th in the standings — outside the top 2 — triggering it.

He has until October to decide. McLaren are the frontrunner. His own race engineer just signed with them.

#F1

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
A soft signal from Max Verstappen?

His "Verstappen Racing" brand has linked up with McLaren to support Belgian junior driver Dries van Langendonck.

His longtime race engineer Lambiase is already at McLaren as Chief Racing Officer.

The October deadline is ticking.

#F1

article.headline: Verstappen's Exit Clause Is Active — McLaren, Lambiase, and an October Deadline

stories.title: Antonelli's Path to History — 50-Point Lead, 291 Points Remaining

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli at the summer break:

219 points. 6 wins. 9 podiums. 50-point lead.

If he holds on, he becomes the youngest F1 world champion since Sebastian Vettel in 2010.

291 points left in 11 rounds. The math is on his side.

#F1 #Formula1

article.headline: Antonelli Heads Into F1's Second Half With a 50-Point Lead — and History Within Reach

Lewis Hamilton is 2nd in the F1 championship at the summer break.

He's also collected FOUR penalties across the last three race weekends.

One false start. One collision. Two at Hungary.

The good news: he's still only 50 points back with 291 remaining.

#F1 #Ferrari

stories.title: Norris Wins Hungarian GP — McLaren's First Victory of 2026

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Lando Norris won the Hungarian GP by 15 seconds.

McLaren's first win of 2026. The defending champion is back.

Meanwhile the early-race squabble with Piastri? Resolved before Norris pulled away.

Red Bull's Verstappen was 2nd. Antonelli 3rd.

#F1 #HungarianGP
